title: Colorado Real Estate Broker
description: Prep for the PSI Colorado broker exam: lessons for the national and Colorado state portions, a 809-question bank with timed exams scored like the real thing, notecards, math drills, a glossary and quick-reference sheets. Independent study material, not affiliated with PSI, the Division of Real Estate or any school. Laws and Commission forms change; check current sources.

title: AP Statistics
description: AP Statistics: exploring one- and two-variable data, z-scores and the normal model, correlation and regression, sampling and experimental design, probability, random variables, sampling distributions and the Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals and significance tests for proportions and means, and chi-square tests, with AP-style four-step inference. Also covers topics the 2026–27 AP framework dropped but college intro courses still teach (geometric distribution, combining random variables, transformations, goodness of fit, slope inference), each marked with an AP scope note.
